title: Tech Lead - Java
description:
Quem somos nós?


Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:


  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?


Estamos em busca de um/uma Tech Lead para integrar nossa equipe de desenvolvimento. Quem ocupar essa posição desempenhará um papel crucial na liderança técnica, garantindo a entrega contínua de valor por meio da otimização do fluxo de valor (Value Stream) e da implementação de soluções de alta qualidade que estejam alinhadas aos objetivos de negócios dos nossos clientes.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?


  • Liderança técnica: Fornece liderança e orientação técnica à equipe de desenvolvimento, estabelecendo padrões de qualidade, aderindo às melhores práticas e garantindo a implementação de soluções técnicas eficientes e escaláveis;
  • Compreensão do fluxo de valor: Trabalha com gerentes de produto, analistas de negócios, arquitetos e desenvolvedores para entender o fluxo de valor completo, desde a concepção da ideia até a entrega do produto, identificando áreas de melhoria e reduzindo desperdícios no processo;
  • Colaboração com equipes multifuncionais: Trabalha em estreita colaboração com gerentes de produto, analistas de negócios, arquitetos e desenvolvedores para entender as necessidades dos negócios, traduzi-las em requisitos técnicos e garantir que as soluções propostas estejam alinhadas com os objetivos gerais do projeto e do cliente;
  • Gerenciamento de projetos e entregas: Monitora o progresso dos projetos, identifique gargalos e proponha soluções para garantir que os prazos e os padrões de qualidade sejam cumpridos. Além disso, coordene a implementação de práticas de CI/CD e automação para otimizar o processo de desenvolvimento e entrega;
  • Planejamento e design técnico: Lidera o planejamento e o design técnico de projetos de integração e API, garantindo a aplicação de melhores práticas, reutilização e escalabilidade. Isto inclui a definição da arquitetura do sistema, a seleção de tecnologias e ferramentas e a identificação de riscos e oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Entrega contínua de valor: Monitora e otimize o fluxo de trabalho da equipe, garantindo a entrega contínua de valor para os clientes e partes interessadas, coordenando práticas de CI/CD e automação para otimizar o processo de desenvolvimento e entrega;
  • Desenvolvimento e revisão de código : Desenvolve acompanha o desenvolvimento de integrações e APIs, fornecendo orientações técnicas e conduzindo revisões de código para garantir a qualidade e a aderência às normas e práticas recomendadas;
  • Mentoria e desenvolvimento da equipe: Promove o crescimento e o desenvolvimento da equipe de desenvolvimento por meio de mentoria, compartilhamento de conhecimento e promoção de um ambiente de aprendizado contínuo. Isso inclui a realização de sessões de treinamento, fornecendo feedback construtivo e apoiando a resolução de problemas complexos;
  • Medição e melhoria de resultados: Utiliza métricas e indicadores relevantes para avaliar o sucesso das soluções entregues, identificar áreas de melhoria e garantir a satisfação das partes interessadas;
  • Comunicação e apresentação de resultados: Comunica-se efetivamente com as partes interessadas em todos os níveis da organização, incluindo a apresentação de resultados, o compartilhamento de atualizações de projetos e a discussão de questões técnicas e de negócios.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa dominar:


  • Conhecimento sólido em linguagens de programação e frameworks relevantes para o domínio do projeto (por exemplo: Java, .NET, JavaScript, Python, etc.), com experiência em desenvolvimento de aplicativos e soluções em ambientes empresariais;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento e design de APIs, incluindo o uso de padrões como REST, SOAP e gRPC;
  • Domínio em arquitetura de sistemas e design de software, incluindo padrões de design, microserviços e arquitetura orientada a eventos;
  • Experiência com práticas de integração de sistemas, como ESB (Enterprise Service Bus), SOA (Arquitetura Orientada a Serviços) e iPaaS (Integration Platform as a Service);
  • Proficiência em bancos de dados e sistemas de gerenciamento de bancos de dados (SQL e NoSQL), bem como em tecnologias de armazenamento e recuperação de dados;
  • Conhecimento em práticas de CI/CD (Integração Contínua e Entrega Contínua) e ferramentas associadas, como Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, CircleCI e Travis CI;
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis de desenvolvimento de software, como Scrum e Kanban, e experiência na aplicação de princípios Lean no gerenciamento de projetos;
  • Domínio em automação de testes e ferramentas de garantia de qualidade, como Selenium, JUnit, TestNG e outras;
  • Conhecimento em segurança de aplicações e APIs, incluindo autenticação, autorização, criptografia e conformidade com regulamentações e padrões relevantes;
  • Experiência em gerenciamento de infraestrutura e serviços em nuvem, como AWS, Azure e Google Cloud Platform;
  • Capacidade de analisar e solucionar problemas de desempenho e escalabilidade, aplicando técnicas de otimização e monitoramento de aplicativos.


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?


  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;
  • Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Mental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Física - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass;
  • Seguro de vida.

title: Senior Data Engineer (SAP Azure) - 131905
description:
O que buscamos:

Profissional de nível Sênior que atue com (Dados / SAP / Azure).

Responsabilidades:

O profissional atuará na construção de pipelines de dados, desenvolvimento de CDS Views e integração SAP → Azure Data Factory → Azure SQL, garantindo qualidade, consistência e disponibilidade de dados para analytics e dashboards estratégicos. Vaga remota.

O Senior Data Engineer será responsável por desenvolver e evoluir pipelines de dados e integrações entre o ambiente SAP e o Data Warehouse corporativo em Azure, garantindo qualidade, consistência e escalabilidade das informações.

Atuará diretamente na extração de dados via CDS Views, integração com Azure Data Factory e construção das camadas de dados no Azure SQL, apoiando a estruturação da arquitetura definitiva do Data Warehouse.

O profissional também contribuirá para garantir que o ambiente de dados esteja preparado para suportar dashboards estratégicos e a migração do sistema SICOF para SAP.

Contexto do Projeto Estamos em fase de estruturação e evolução do Data Warehouse corporativo, com foco na transição para o SAP como sistema definitivo.

O profissional atuará no projeto SAP, sendo responsável por: Criação e ajuste de CDS Views no SAP;

Extração de dados via Azure Data Factory

Enriquecimento do Data Warehouse (Azure SQL);

Garantia de qualidade e consistência dos dados;

Apoio na construção da arquitetura definitiva de dados.


  • Desenvolver CDS Views avançadas no SAP (associations, annotations, performance tuning);
  • Ajustar e otimizar views existentes Integrar dados SAP → Azure Data Factory → Azure SQL;
  • Implementar pipelines de ingestão e cargas incrementais;
  • Garantir qualidade, consistência e integridade dos dados;
  • Apoiar na definição da arquitetura do Data Warehouse;
  • Avaliar necessidade de modelagem dimensional (Star Schema);
  • Apoiar na evolução da governança de dados;
  • Colaborar com times de dados, BI e arquitetura para garantir disponibilidade e confiabilidade das informações.


Requisitos :


  • SAP;
  • Experiência sólida com CDS Views avançadas;
  • Experiência com performance tuning em extração SAP Azure;
  • Experiência com Azure Data Factory (pipelines, triggers, integration runtime);
  • Experiência com Azure SQL;
  • Experiência em arquiteturas de dados com camadas Bronze / Silver / Gold;
  • Engenharia de Dados Experiência com ETL e/ou ELT;
  • Implementação de cargas incrementais;
  • Práticas de Data Quality;
  • Experiência com integração SAP → Data Warehouse.


Diferencial:


  • Experiência em projetos de migração de ERP;
  • Experiência estruturando Data Warehouses corporativos;
  • Capacidade de propor arquitetura de dados;
  • Experiência com Power BI para construção de dashboards;
  • Experiência com governança de dados.


Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.

title: Sales Specialist
description:
Position : Sales Specialist (Personal Branding Websites)

Company : Pella Force / Pella Nova

Location : Remote

Employment Type : Remote / Commission-Based


About Pella Nova

Pella Nova builds SEO- and AI-optimized personal websites designed to strengthen digital authority. These websites position professionals clearly in Google and AI systems, creating trust, visibility, and stronger deal flow.


Role Overview

The Sales Specialist leads conversations with professionals and business owners, introduces the concept of digital authority, and guides them toward creating a personal website that reflects their expertise and positioning.

This is a fully commission-based role, designed for individuals who are driven by performance and results, with direct earnings tied to closed deals.


Key Responsibilities

  • Initiate and manage conversations with potential clients (B2B & personal brands)
  • Identify gaps in online presence, visibility, and positioning
  • Present Pella Nova websites as a strategic asset for trust and conversion
  • Guide prospects from first contact to closing
  • Maintain consistent follow-ups and relationship management
  • Collaborate with internal team for smooth project onboarding
  • Track pipeline and personal performance


Requirements

  • Strong communication and persuasion skills
  • Ability to lead conversations with professionals and decision-makers
  • Results-driven mindset with focus on closing deals
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment


Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of digital marketing, SEO, or personal branding
  • Experience in sales or business development
  • Understanding of how online visibility impacts trust and revenue


What Defines Success in This Role

  • Consistent deal closure
  • Strong ability to position websites as a business necessity
  • High activity level (outreach, calls, follow-ups)
  • Full ownership of personal sales results

title: Application Security Engineer
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Application Security Engineer with 5+ years of experience to help strengthen the security posture of the software platforms. This role will be responsible for reviewing application code, identifying security vulnerabilities, and working closely with development teams to ensure secure coding practices are followed throughout the software development lifecycle.


The ideal candidate will have strong experience in application penetration testing, fraud detection and analysis, and secure software development practices. This individual will play a key role in proactively identifying risks in PHP, Python, and Angular applications, while also educating development teams on secure coding standards and best practices.


Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class property management system integrating booking, guest communications, and financial reporting systems - all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities:

  • Conduct regular security assessments, code reviews, and penetration testing to identify vulnerabilities in applications and software, including manual and automated code reviews for applications written in PHP, Python, and Angular
  • Analyze applications for common vulnerabilities such as those identified in the OWASP Top 10, including risks related to authentication, authorization, data validation, and session management
  • Conduct application penetration testing and vulnerability assessments on web applications and APIs, simulating real-world attack scenarios to uncover security weaknesses and documenting findings with recommended mitigation strategies
  • Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments to proactively identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies
  • Track, analyze, and manage vulnerabilities in applications while providing guidance and support for remediation efforts
  • Analyze application behavior and transaction patterns to detect potential fraud or abuse scenarios and identify vulnerabilities that could enable account takeover, payment fraud, or data manipulation
  • Partner with engineering and product teams to design controls that reduce fraud risk.
  • Work closely with development teams to ensure security best practices are integrated throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC), including developing secure coding guidelines, delivering secure coding training, and providing guidance during design and architecture reviews
  • Design, develop, and implement security tools, frameworks, and methodologies to protect applications against security threats, including integrating and maintaining security testing tools such as SAST, DAST, and dependency scanning within CI/CD pipelines
  • Assist in investigating, analyzing, and responding to security incidents related to applications, ensuring timely resolution and documentation of incidents
  • Track vulnerabilities and remediation progress through internal ticketing systems while collaborating with engineering, DevOps, and product teams to improve the overall application security posture and assist in developing internal security policies and procedures


Required Experience:

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of experience in application security, penetration testing, or secure software development
  • Strong understanding of web application security principles and the OWASP Top 10
  • Experience reviewing code in PHP, Python, and modern JavaScript frameworks such as Angular
  • Experience performing application penetration testing and vulnerability assessments
  • Knowledge of authentication, authorization, encryption, and secure session management
  • Experience identifying and mitigating fraud or abuse patterns in applications
  • Familiarity with common security testing tools (e.g., Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Snyk, SonarQube, etc.)
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain security issues to non-security engineers


Desired Experience:

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience integrating security testing into CI/CD pipelines
  • Familiarity with cloud security principles
  • Experience with secure architecture reviews
  • Relevant certifications such as OSCP, CEH, GWAPT, or CSSLP
  • Experience working in agile development environments


Additional Information:

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient:

Venha para uma das maiores empresas de Serviços IT do mundo!! Aqui você pode transformar sua carreira!


Por que fazer parte da TCS? Aqui na TCS acreditamos que as pessoas fazem a diferença, por isso vivemos uma cultura de aprendizado ilimitado cheio de oportunidades de melhorias e desenvolvimento mútuo. O cenário ideal para expandir ideias através das ferramentas certas, contribuindo para nosso sucesso num ambiente colaborativo.


Estamos buscando um(a) Desenvolvedor Senior Front-end React.js para atuar em uma squad ágil orientada a fluxo (Kanban), responsável por construir e evoluir produtos digitais de alto impacto. O profissional trabalhará em parceria com Product Owner, UX/UI, back-end, QA e demais papéis do time, entregando para clientes internos e externos.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência sólida com React.js (hooks, context, roteamento, estado, lifecycle).
  • Domínio de JavaScript ES6+ e TypeScript.
  • Familiaridade com Redux, Zustand, Recoil ou outros gestores de estado.
  • Conhecimento em HTML5, CSS3, SASS, Styled Components, CSS-in-JS.
  • Experiência com consumo de APIs REST ou GraphQL.
  • Ferramentas de build e empacotamento (Vite, Webpack, Babel).
  • Testes com Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress ou equivalentes.
  • Git, versionamento moderno e Git Flow (ou trunk-based com PRs).
  • Experiência prévia em ambientes ágeis (Kanban, Lean, Agile mindset).


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver interfaces modernas, performáticas e responsivas utilizando React.js, JavaScript/TypeScript e o ecossistema associado.
  • Trabalhar em uma flow-based system com práticas de Kanban, contribuindo para a melhoria contínua do fluxo de trabalho (WIP, lead time, cycle time, throughput, CFD).
  • Participar ativamente das cerimônias do time, como refinamentos, dailys, análises de fluxo e retrospectivas focadas em otimização de processo.
  • Colaborar com UX/UI para transformar protótipos e conceitos em experiências reais.
  • Integrar o front-end com APIs e serviços back-end, garantindo padronização e qualidade técnica.
  • Realizar code reviews, apoiar na evolução da arquitetura front-end e garantir boas práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Criar e manter testes (unitários, integração e E2E) para assegurar confiabilidade e estabilidade.
  • Atuar com mentalidade de ownership do produto, entendendo o impacto das entregas no negócio.
  • Colaborar com o Chapter de Front-end e Guildas técnicas, compartilhando conhecimento e boas práticas.



O que oferecemos?

  • Benefícios TCS – Brasil:
  • Plano de Saúde
  • Plano Odontológico
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Vale Transporte
  • Vale Refeição/Alimentação
  • Auxílio Creche
  • Totalpass
  • TCS Cares – 0800 gratuito que fornece assistência psicológica (24 hrs/dia), jurídica, social e financeira aos associados
  • Parceria com SESC
  • Reembolso de Certificações
  • Portal de aprendizagem gratuito da TCS – cursos online e treinamentos ao vivo
  • Oportunidade de experiência internacional
  • Parceria de Descontos com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas
  • Bring Your Buddy – Ao indicar pessoas você se torna elegível a receber um bônus para cada contratação
  • TCS Gems – Reconhecimento por performance
  • Xcelerate – Plataforma de carreira com mentoria gratuita


Na TATA Consultancy Services promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, trabalhamos sempre pela equidade. Isso se aplica em Gênero, Pessoas com Deficiência, LGBTQIA+, Religião, Raça, Etnia, ou seja, todas as nossas oportunidades são trabalhadas com esses princípios. Pensamos em ações diversas de inclusão e de responsabilidade social, a fim de construir uma TCS que respeita a individualidade. Seja um TCSer!

title: Full Stack Sênior - Node/TypeScript(React)
description:
Sobre a TIVIT | Seu futuro, nosso desafio


A TIVIT é uma multinacional brasileira e one-stop-shop de tecnologia, presente no mercado há 20 anos e com operação em dez países da América Latina. Por meio de quatro unidades de negócios: Digital Business , Cloud Solutions, CyberSecurity e Technology Platforms , a empresa oferece respostas personalizadas e soluções que impactam nos negócios, e na rotina de empresas e pessoas.

A companhia conta com uma forte estratégia de inovação, com o TIVIT Labs (hub que apoia as empresas a descobrirem e solucionarem os seus maiores desafios de inovação) e a TIVIT Ventures, braço de aquisição de empresas inovadoras, que já conta com as marcas Stone Age, tbankS, Privally, DevApi, Lambda3, SENSR.IT e XMS.


Entregar valor para as empresas que trabalham conosco é um esforço que exige uma constante coordenação entre todas as partes da TIVIT. Nos orgulhamos de ser uma empresa que entrega serviços e produtos de ponta-a-ponta (da proposta, passando por todo ciclo de vida, à entrega), por isso, ao trabalhar conosco você vai ter contato com profissionais que possuem diversas experiências em projetos e clientes variados


Descrição da posição Full Stack (Node.js/Typescript) - Sênior

  • 100% Remoto / Contratação CLT
  • Buscamos uma pessoa que possua perfil de liderança, com pelo menos 5 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software, que será referência técnica dentro do time de projeto e apoiará no dia a dia no contato com o cliente. Além disso, esta pessoa precisa estar disposta a aprender e ensinar em todos os momentos, sair da zona de conforto e que possam contribuir com times auto gerenciáveis.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Participar desde a ideação e concepção de produtos e serviços, até sua entrega e sustentação;
  • Fazer escolhas e/ou discussões das tecnologias que serão empregadas em projetos;
  • Participar e contribuir com projetos que utilizam metodologias de entrega ágil, integração contínua e desenvolvimento guiado por testes (TDD ), comportamento (BDD ), técnicas de modelagem e pair programming;
  • Contribuir com a evolução dos nossos projetos sendo parte de um time de alta performance que atua diretamente com empresas de relevância nacional e internacional.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Ensino Superior completo ;
  • Perfil com foco em BackEnd
  • Experiência de desenvolvimento utilizando NodeJS com NestJS;
  • Experiência com Javascript e Typescript (mais Typescript do que JS puro);
  • Sólido conhecimento em JavaScript, HTML, CSS e princípios de desenvolvimento front-end.
  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento guiado por testes (TDD ) e comportamento (BDD )
  • Capacidade de criar componentes reutilizáveis e manter código limpo e escalável.
  • Experiência com React.js ;
  • Experiência com Azure Cloud;
  • Container Apps;
  • Function Apps;
  • Observabilidade com Service Bus;
  • Event Hub;
  • Blob Storage;
  • Azure Cosmos Db (Mongo Db);
  • Azure Database (PostgresSQL);
  • Azure DevOps;
  • Azure Pipelines (para CI/CD);
  • Experiência com ferramentas de CI/CD
  • ELK (monitoramento);
  • Elasticsearch;
  • APM;
  • Prática com estratégias de branch
  • Conhecimento em Arquitetura limpa e/ou arquitetura hexagonal
  • Experiência com SOLID
  • Experiência com Microservices
  • Mensageria (Kafka,RabbitMQ );
  • Git;


Experiências técnicas desejáveis:

  • Experiência com Padrões/design de Software
  • Conhecimento em frameworks e bibliotecas relacionadas, como React Router, Material-UI, ou Styled Components,


O que oferecemos para você?

✔Vale Refeição ou Alimentação;

✔Assistência médica e Odontológica;

✔Convênio Farmácia (descontos na compra de medicamentos);

✔Seguro de Vida;

✔Convênio Academia;

✔TIVIT Club (descontos e parcerias com as melhores lojas);

✔PAC - Programa de aceleração de carreira;

✔Reembolso para certificações;

✔MOBIFLIX – Nossa academia corporativa tem cursos presenciais e online, alinhados as novas tendências do mercado de tecnologia;

✔Plataforma online de crédito consignado, a TIVIT te ajuda a realizar os seus objetivos pessoais como reforma no seu apê/casa, financiar estudos e quitar dívidas, de acordo com as regras e políticas da cia;

✔Programa de Apoio Pessoal com orientação psicológica, financeira e jurídica em parceria com a Alelo.


Acreditamos que o presente é plural e a inclusão transforma, por isso, todas as pessoas são bem-vindas em nossas vagas, para promovermos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo, de respeito, justiça e equidade.

title: Scala Developer
description:
Want to Make Waves in Tech? GBT Solutions Is the Place to Be!


About Us: GBT Solutions is a Portuguese technology company founded in 2018, part of the HFA Group established in 1995. With a focus on delivering cutting-edge solutions across various industries, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment and are proud to be recognized for our commitment to excellence and innovation.


Position: Scala Developer

Location: Remote for UK


What You’ll Do

  • Design, develop, and maintain backend services using Scala 2.13 and Play Framework .
  • Build robust integrations with MySQL , Redis , and AWS services.
  • Optimize SQL queries, indexes, and database performance.
  • Write clean, maintainable, testable code following functional programming principles.
  • Contribute to system architecture evolution with a focus on performance and horizontal scalability.

Equal Opportunity: GBT Solutions is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on age, ethnicity, sexual orientation, gender, disability, or any other factor other than merit.

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Marketing
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.


A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.



Responsabilidades e atribuições:


  • Coordenação do Departamento de Marketing compreendendo Trade, Comunicação, CRM e Programa de Benefícios;
  • Planejamento do calendário anual de campanhas e eventos e elaboração de plano de marketing com o orçamento de despesas de sua área;
  • Controle financeiro;
  • Negociação com parceiros e patrocínios;
  • Interface com agência de publicidade e promoção: elaboração de briefings de campanhas, plano de mídia, comunicação interna do shopping, campanhas promocionais (mecânica, documentação, premiação, prestação de contas);
  • Responsável pela comunicação do shopping com a assessoria de imprensa: aprovação de releases e sugestão de pautas;
  • Preservar a imagem do empreendimento junto ao público em geral e lojistas;
  • Contribuir com a Gerência de Marketing, participando de reuniões sistemáticas com a equipe para avaliação de metas setoriais, acompanhamento dos indicadores de qualidade, desenvolvimento de planos de melhoria contínua e intercâmbio de informações.


Requisitos e qualificações:


  • Ensino superior completo em Marketing, Comunicação, Publicidade e áreas correlatas;
  • Diferenciais: MBA em administração, comunicação, marketing, produção de eventos.
  • Pacote Office Avançado;


Informações adicionais:

title: Especialista em Branding
description:
Olá, somos a SuperFrete :)


Queremos ser a maior e mais amada rede de logística digital, quer fazer parte disso?

Somos uma startup que atua no segmento do varejo e logística, apoiando os pequenos e médios empreendedores a se tornarem mais competitivos no mercado e a alavancarem suas vendas. Por isso, buscamos um Super Especialista em Branding , que se identifique com o nosso propósito, que tenha muita energia para somar no time de Marketing e que queira crescer (muito!) com a gente.



Responsabilidades


  • Liderar e apoiar o desenvolvimento do Brand System da SuperFrete (brandbook, tom de voz, diretrizes visuais e narrativas, em todos os canais da marca incluindo redes sociais, endomarketing e assessoria de imprensa);
  • Garantir a consistência da identidade da marca em todos os pontos de contato;
  • Criar guidelines, playbooks e briefings estratégicos para campanhas e conteúdos;
  • Acompanhar cronogramas, entregas e qualidade das iniciativas de branding;
  • Conduzir análises de mercado, auditorias de marca e acompanhamento de indicadores de branding;
  • Criar e conduzir workshops de marca para equipes internas e novas lideranças;
  • Trabalhar em parceria com diferentes áreas e squads para garantir a aplicação correta das diretrizes da marca;
  • Conduzir a evolução do posicionamento da marca, identificando oportunidades no ecossistema de e-commerce, logística e empreendedorismo;
  • Liderar iniciativas estratégicas de branding e gerenciar relacionamento com agências, consultorias e parceiros criativos;
  • Planejar a presença da marca em eventos do setor, garantindo experiências alinhadas ao posicionamento da SuperFrete;
  • Contribuir para o fortalecimento da cultura de marca e marca empregadora dentro da organização.
  • Liderar a estratégia de PR e relacionamento com imprensa, identificando oportunidades de exposição institucional da marca.



Requisitos


  • Ensino superior completo em Publicidade e Propaganda, Jornalismo, Marketing ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência na gestão e aplicação de Brand Systems (brandbook, diretrizes visuais e tom de voz);
  • Conhecimento em pesquisas de marca, análise de mercado e concorrência;
  • Experiência em projetos de branding ou rebranding;
  • Capacidade de definir, planejar e executar estratégias de marca;
  • Habilidade para identificar tendências de mercado e comportamento do consumidor;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de storytelling e excelente habilidade de escrita;
  • Capacidade de transitar entre diferentes contextos, projetos e stakeholders;
  • Olhar crítico para identidade visual e revisão de peças (texto e design);
  • Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplos projetos e iniciativas de marca simultaneamente.



Diferenciais


  • Vivência em ambientes dinâmicos, como startups ou empresas em processo de expansão;
  • Experiência com produção de eventos corporativos;
  • Experiência com assessoria de imprensa.



O que você pode esperar dos Supers?


  • Uma cultura de muita confiança, colaboração, focada em resultados, com muita autonomia e transparência;
  • Buscamos excelência em tudo o que fazemos, por isso estamos sempre aprendendo;
  • Temos vontade de construir junto, fazer a diferença e gerar impacto.



O que oferecemos:

title: Senior Content Manager
description:
As a Senior Content Manager, you will play a key role in supporting MoveUp Media’s growth by owning the operational and strategic execution of content across our website portfolio. You will take ownership of content performance and strategy across our websites, while leading day-to-day content operations and working closely with SEO and cross-functional teams. You will be responsible for turning content and SEO strategies into measurable results, while ensuring high-quality standards across multi-language teams and markets.


This role contributes directly to the CORE department’s objectives by supporting the growth, stability, and diversification of the business through content performance, strong processes, and effective collaboration. You will act as the main point of ownership for content quality and delivery, working closely with SEO, Product, and cross-functional teams.


To be more specific, you will:


  • Lead and develop the content strategy for our flagship, multi-language websites across multiple markets
  • Manage content workflows and ensure consistent, high-quality output across all sites
  • Oversee content quality, structure, and standards across our portfolio
  • Work proactively with content teams to define and implement content checklists and best practices
  • Collaborate closely with SEO, Tech, Design, and Product teams to ensure content and SEO best practices are followed
  • Ensure all SEO and content checks are completed ahead of website launches or redesigns
  • Regularly review websites to identify issues, suggest improvements, and support teams with implementation
  • Monitor content performance and report progress and key initiatives to senior stakeholders
  • Ensure content meets compliance and regulatory requirements and oversee necessary updates
  • Stay up to date with market trends, best practices, and iGaming innovations
  • Support hiring and team development (mentoring) in collaboration with Talent Acquisition and HR.


The ideal profile


We’re looking for a Senior Content Manager ready to step into a Lead role — someone who takes ownership of content performance, works independently, and collaborates closely with SEO to drive results.


You are someone who:


  • Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role
  • Has iGaming experience (a strong plus, not a must)
  • Has a background in journalism, communications, or a related field (a plus)
  • Has an excellent command of English and a strong eye for content quality and consistency
  • Is comfortable reviewing and optimising content rather than writing it


You bring strong CM fundamentals:


  • High level of autonomy and strong task prioritisation skills
  • Ownership mindset over site and content performance
  • Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into clear actions
  • Strategic thinking and the ability to plan toward defined goals
  • Experience working with CMS platforms


You work well with others and think ahead:


  • Collaborative approach, especially when working with SEO teams
  • Proactive in sharing ideas, flagging issues, and suggesting improvements
  • Open to experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement
  • Positive attitude with a growth mindset and leadership potential


Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.


Next steps in the process ✅


  • 1rst Interview with your future manager to make sure you meet the role’s requirements
  • 2nd interview with HR to better understand who you are and make sure there is a cultural fit with MoveUp Media
  • Last step: a proposition for us to start working together!


What’s in it for you


  • A full time remote work environment.
  • A flexible schedule and paid time off. We measure results , not hours.
  • Competitive salary, depending on your level of seniority in the role and your location
  • Development opportunities. As a startup with rapid growth, there are a lot of possibilities that can arise and we are committed to accompany our team members in their career path.
  • Yearly get together with the team to connect, work and have fun . We strive to find good spots for everyone to enjoy the stay!


MoveUp Media

title: Founding General Manager / Operating Partner
description:
About CoHostly

CoHostly is a growing SaaS company focused on building software and systems that solve real operational problems in the rental car space. We are looking for a high-level operator who can help turn a fast-moving company into a more structured, scalable business.

This is not a normal job. This is a high-ownership role for someone who wants to help build something meaningful from the ground up and work directly with the founder to drive execution, growth, and long-term value.


About the role

We are hiring a Founding General Manager / Operating Partner to help lead execution across the business. This person will help bring structure, accountability, and momentum to CoHostly while taking a major load off the founder.

This role is ideal for someone who is strong in operations, growth, sales support, team coordination, and making things happen in early-stage environments.


What you’ll be responsible for

  • Help run day-to-day execution across the business
  • Build structure, systems, and accountability around priorities
  • Coordinate projects across product, operations, sales, and growth
  • Work closely with the founder to turn ideas into execution
  • Help manage contractors, remote team members, and key initiatives
  • Support customer onboarding, retention, and feedback loops
  • Help identify bottlenecks, solve problems, and keep the company moving fast
  • Create visibility around KPIs, priorities, and weekly progress
  • Contribute to growth efforts including partnerships, outbound support, and business development initiatives


Who we’re looking for

  • Strong operator with experience in startups, SaaS, fintech, marketplaces, or high-growth businesses
  • Highly organized and execution-focused
  • Able to work directly with a founder and thrive in a fast-moving environment
  • Strong communicator who can manage moving pieces and drive progress
  • Comfortable wearing multiple hats across ops, growth, sales support, and team coordination
  • Resourceful, proactive, and able to solve problems without constant direction
  • Serious about building, not just collecting a paycheck


Preferred background

  • Experience working in a startup or early-stage company
  • Experience in business operations, product operations, general management, chief of staff, or growth
  • Experience helping scale teams, systems, or revenue
  • Experience managing remote teams or contractors
  • Bonus if you have experience in SaaS, fintech, automotive, fleet, or marketplace businesses


What success looks like

In the first 90 days, you should be able to:

  • create more structure and accountability across the business
  • improve execution speed
  • organize priorities and workflows

Our client is pioneering the future of embedded analytics with AI at the core. If you're passionate about driving strategic customer success in AI-powered analytics, apply today. Let’s build the next era of intelligent decisions together.

title: Senior Applied Scientist (AI/ML - Inbound Team)
description:
Senior Applied Scientist – AI/ML Customer Science (Remote – Brazil)


Location: 100% Remote (Brazil)

Employment Type: PJ – Long term


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Applied Scientist to design, develop, and deploy advanced machine learning, causal inference, and optimization systems that drive Marketing and Sales decision-making.

In this role, you will transform complex customer behavior and business growth challenges into measurable objectives and scalable ML solutions across acquisition, conversion, retention, and revenue optimization.

You will work at the intersection of machine learning, experimentation, causal inference, and business strategy in a fast-paced, collaborative, and entrepreneurial environment.


What You’ll Work On

You will build models and platforms that create impact across areas such as:

  • Sales prioritization and expected value modeling
  • Marketing targeting and uplift modeling
  • Multi-touch attribution and incrementality measurement
  • Customer lifecycle modeling (conversion, retention, churn, LTV)
  • Outreach optimization and personalization systems


Responsibilities

  • Research, design, and develop machine learning, statistical, and causal models for Marketing and Sales use cases including:
  • Propensity and expected value modeling
  • Uplift and treatment effect estimation
  • Attribution and marketing measurement
  • Forecasting, optimization, and prioritization systems
  • Translate business growth problems into clear objectives, loss functions, and evaluation frameworks
  • Design feature representations capturing customer behavior, engagement, and lifecycle dynamics
  • Design and analyze experiments (A/B tests, geo tests, incrementality tests, diff-in-diff, causal impact)
  • Build and maintain robust evaluation frameworks aligned with business outcomes (ROI, CAC, conversion, retention, LTV)
  • Own the end-to-end ML lifecycle: data ingestion, feature engineering, training, deployment, monitoring
  • Develop scalable ML services integrated into business workflows (CRM, marketing platforms, internal tools)
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, and Data teams
  • Influence technical direction and roadmap prioritization based on business impact
  • Clearly communicate insights and model behavior to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Mentor junior scientists and engineers and help establish best practices
  • Contribute to long-term data science strategy, platforms, and innovation


Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of industry experience in applied Machine Learning
  • Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Operations Research, or related field
  • 3+ years of experience building, deploying, and managing ML models in production at scale
  • Strong knowledge of ML best practices (feature engineering, experimentation, pipelines, model evaluation)
  • Experience with modern ML techniques including gradient boosting, deep learning, transformers, and optimization
  • Experience in Computer Vision (Causal Inference experience is a strong plus)
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL
  • Hands-on experience with ML frameworks: PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, Scikit-learn
  • Strong data engineering skills with large-scale datasets
  • Experience with big data tools such as Apache Beam, Kafka, Spark
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)


Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in CS, ML, AI, Statistics, Operations Research, or related field
  • Experience applying ML in retail or commercial business contexts
  • Familiarity with MLOps tools and production pipelines
  • Strong leadership and mentoring experience
  • Impact-driven mindset with a focus on delivering high-quality, scalable solutions

title: Digital Ad Designer
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle—from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

As a Digital Ad Designer at Lilo Social, you will create scroll-stopping static graphics for Meta advertising campaigns while designing high-converting landing pages that drive measurable results for DTC brands. You will collaborate closely with creative strategists and media buyers to translate performance insights into compelling visual creative that captures attention and converts browsers into buyers.


What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent improvement in creative performance metrics (CTR, conversion rate, thumb-stop rate) across your client portfolio
  • Fast iteration speed that enables creative variations per week with maintained quality standards
  • High client satisfaction through on-brand designs that align with strategic creative direction
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration that accelerates testing velocity and produces scalable winning concepts


Responsibilities

  • Design high-performing static graphics for Meta ad campaigns across feed, stories, and reels formats
  • Create conversion-focused landing pages that align with ad messaging and drive customer action
  • Execute on creative briefs provided by strategists, translating concepts into visually compelling designs
  • Iterate quickly based on performance data, A/B test results, and stakeholder feedback
  • Maintain brand consistency and visual standards across multiple client accounts simultaneously
  • Design mobile-first experiences optimized for Meta's platform specifications and best practices
  • Organize and manage design files, asset libraries, and version control using established naming conventions
  • Collaborate with media buyers to understand campaign objectives and creative testing priorities
  • Stay current on Meta platform trends, ad formats, and direct response design principles
  • Produce landing page designs that integrate seamlessly with existing brand systems and conversion frameworks
  • Participate in creative reviews and provide design rationale grounded in performance marketing principles
  • Adapt existing creative concepts into new formats, sizes, and placements efficiently


Requirements

  • 3-4 years of design experience in performance marketing, advertising, or DTC ecommerce
  • Expert proficiency in Figma for design collaboration and file organization
  • Strong command of Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop and Illustrator)
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response creative and performance-focused design work
  • Proven experience designing ads specifically for Meta (Facebook and Instagram)
  • Understanding of mobile-first design principles and responsive layout techniques
  • Demonstrated ability to iterate quickly while maintaining high quality standards
  • Experience designing landing pages with conversion rate optimization in mind
  • Organized approach to file management with attention to naming conventions and version control
  • Comfort working with performance feedback and data-driven design decisions
  • Strong communication skills and ability to articulate design decisions
  • Self-starter mentality with ability to manage multiple client accounts and deadlines


Nice to Have

  • Motion graphics or animation skills with proficiency in After Effects or similar tools
  • Experience with landing page builders (Unbounce, Instapage, Replo, Shogun)
  • HTML/CSS knowledge for basic landing page customization
  • Understanding of Meta Ads Manager and campaign performance metrics
  • Experience working in an agency environment with multiple simultaneous client accounts
  • Familiarity with Shopify and ecommerce product page design
  • Knowledge of direct response copywriting principles and how they inform design hierarchy
  • Experience designing for additional platforms (TikTok, Google Display, YouTube)


Compensation and Benefits

  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture
  • Generous Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: Web Content Editor / Web QA (Growth Role)
description:
Location: Brazil

Team: Digital / Web


Company Description


Bucksense, Inc. is a company dedicated to bridging the gap between brands and publishers by fostering an open and trustworthy environment. We leverage creativity, skilled professionals, and advanced technology to drive marketing performance across multiple channels. Our services for brands empower businesses to take control of their digital marketing strategies, data, and outcomes, while our DirectoPub platform offers publishers innovative opportunities to optimize revenue. At Bucksense, we combine technology with human expertise to provide a unified platform for managing marketing operations effectively. Our mission is to deliver impactful results with efficiency and clarity.


Role Overview


We are seeking a digitally savvy, detail-oriented Web Content Editor with a strong interest in web quality assurance and UX excellence. This role sits at the intersection of editorial, web publishing, and QA, and is ideal for a mid-level professional who wants to grow into a QA leadership role over time.


You will be responsible for ensuring that all web content across our travel portals is clear, accurate, consistent, accessible, and presented to a high standard, while also progressively taking ownership of content-related QA processes and cross-team quality checks.


You will collaborate closely with content creators, designers, developers, and marketing teams to ensure a polished, high-quality web experience.


Key Responsibilities:


Content Editing & Publishing

  • Edit, proofread, and publish web content to ensure clarity, accuracy, grammar, and alignment with brand guidelines.
  • Maintain consistency in tone, style, formatting, and structure across pages.
  • Manage and update content within a CMS (e.g., Sanity, WordPress, or similar).
  • Coordinate content updates with writers, designers, developers, and stakeholders.
  • Maintain an editorial calendar and oversee timely content updates.


UX, Accessibility & Content Quality

  • Review content presentation across devices to ensure usability, readability, and mobile optimization.
  • Ensure accessibility best practices are followed (e.g., alt text, content structure, readability).
  • Apply UX and SEO best practices, including internal linking and content optimization.
  • Assess image quality, typography, layout, and overall visual presentation.


Web QA & Quality Ownership

  • Perform content-focused QA checks to ensure pages are published correctly and meet quality standards.
  • Identify and flag content-related issues such as broken links, formatting errors, incorrect displays, or inconsistencies.
  • Collaborate with developers and designers to resolve quality issues.
  • Contribute to the development of QA standards, checklists, and processes related to web content.
  • Gradually take increased ownership of web quality assurance as part of a long-term growth path toward QA leadership.


Performance & Optimization

  • Monitor website performance and user engagement using analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics).
  • Conduct regular content audits to identify outdated, underperforming, or improvement-ready content.
  • Recommend enhancements based on data and qualitative review.


Qualifications & Skills

  • 2+ years of experience in digital content editing, web publishing, or content operations.
  • Strong editorial skills: writing, editing, and proofreading with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Hands-on experience working with CMS platforms (Sanity, WordPress, or headless CMS).
  • Working knowledge of HTML/CSS for light formatting and layout adjustments.
  • Solid understanding of UX principles, accessibility, and mobile-first web best practices.
  • Comfort reviewing web pages for quality, consistency, and presentation issues.
  • Experience using analytics tools to assess content performance.
  • Organized, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple content workflows.
  • Interest in growing into a broader QA-focused role over time.


Nice to Have

  • Prior exposure to web QA, content QA, or digital quality processes.
  • Experience in travel, lifestyle, luxury, or e-commerce environments.
  • Familiarity with structured QA documentation or checklists.


Growth Opportunity

This role is designed to evolve over time, with the opportunity to grow into a lead QA role for web content and digital experience, helping define standards and processes across our platforms.

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
ABOUT US

Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.


Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.



THE ROLE

The Manager I of Engineering plays a key leadership role, directly managing a small team of software engineers. This role is responsible for ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software projects, fostering a collaborative and inclusive team culture, and supporting the professional growth of engineers.

In addition to leading day-to-day execution, this manager contributes to tactical decision-making, participates in architectural discussions, and ensures engineering efforts are aligned with project goals. They collaborate closely with product, design, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver solutions that support Syniti’s broader mission.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Manage and support a team of software engineers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope.

• Provide coaching, mentorship, and regular performance feedback to support individual growth.

• Guide the team in applying engineering best practices, including code reviews, testing, and secure development.

• Participate in architectural and technical design discussions, ensuring sound engineering decisions.

• Collaborate closely with product and cross-functional teams to align priorities and deliver value.

• Help shape a positive and inclusive team culture that fosters engagement, learning, and innovation.

• Identify and address delivery risks, blockers, or process gaps within the team’s scope.

• Contribute to hiring and onboarding of new engineers, and support team scaling efforts.



WHAT IT TAKES

• Proven experience as a team lead or first-line engineering manager in a software development environment.

• Strong technical foundation in modern software development (e.g., C#, Go, React, TypeScript, AWS).

• Familiarity with agile development methodologies, DevOps practices, and software delivery processes.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and support the growth of engineering team members.

• Experience participating in technical design, architecture reviews, and secure development practices.

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, distributed, and cross-functional environment.


Be fully aligned to our core values:

• Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.

• Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.

• Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.

• Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.



WHAT WE OFFER

• Trust in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style.

• Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.

• Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.

• Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all.

• Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.

• An open organisation. Titles don’t define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone’s work is seen and valued.



Our Commitment to Inclusion

At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Freight Desk Manager
description:
Position Scope

The Freight Desk Manager is a high-impact leadership role responsible for architecting and overseeing the logistics support function for non-finished goods on a global scale, with a dedicated focus on the LATAM region . This position operates at the intersection of global procurement and operational execution, managing a complex ecosystem of freight forwarders, control towers, and internal stakeholders. The mission is to ensure world-class shipment execution and financial integrity through robust audit structures and the expansion of logistics capabilities in high-growth markets.

Responsibilities and Accountabilities

  • Regional Strategy & Expansion: Serve as the primary architect for logistics operations in LATAM, including the enablement of Importer of Record (IOR) operations and regional supplier onboarding.
  • Global Freight Desk Leadership: Lead the logistics support function for specialized shipments, managing a network of global freight forwarders operating through dedicated control towers.
  • Rate Card Governance: Standardize and maintain global Bulk Air and Ocean rate cards across a diverse portfolio of international suppliers to ensure cost consistency and transparency.
  • Strategic Sourcing: Lead RFQs and supplier onboarding initiatives for logistics, ensuring all partners meet global compliance and service level standards.
  • Governance & Audit Architecture: Design and maintain a global freight audit strategy and control architecture to ensure financial discipline across high-volume global invoice environments.
  • Control Tower Oversight: Drive operational excellence by governing forwarder performance, ensuring industry-leading on-time shipment execution across all transport modes.
  • Automation & Process Engineering: Implement automated invoice approval systems and systemic controls to improve first-pass yield and overall operational efficiency.
  • Stakeholder Management: Partner with global cross-functional teams to support non-standard logistics requirements and rapid-response delivery programs.

Mandatory Requirements

  • Experience: Extensive experience in Global Supply Management, Logistics Procurement, or Supply Chain Operations within multinational environments.
  • Regional Expertise: Deep knowledge of the LATAM logistics landscape , including regulatory requirements, customs, and supplier networks.
  • Procurement Mastery: Proven track record in leading RFQs and managing complex logistics supplier onboarding processes.
  • Network Management: Experience managing large-scale global freight forwarder relationships and \"Control Tower\" operational models.
  • Technical Proficiency: Strong background in Logistics Financial Control (Freight Audit) and managing high-volume, global-scale invoice environments.
  • Leadership: Experience leading international teams and managing external providers across different time zones (APAC, EMEA, AMR).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, International Trade, or a related field.
  • Languages: Fluency in English is essential for regional and global coordination.

Desirable Requirements

  • Advanced Education: MBA or Master’s degree.
  • Process Excellence: Certifications in Lean Six Sigma or similar experience.
  • Digital Transformation: Experience implementing AI-driven or automated financial auditing and rate management tools.
  • Rapid Growth Background: Experience managing logistics for hyper-growth programs (e.g., international express expansions or specialized delivery models).

title: Amazon Graphic Designer / Creative Strategist
description:
We are hiring an Amazon Graphic Designer to own the strategic development and execution of premium marketplace creatives.


This is not a task-based production role. We are looking for someone who can think strategically, identify what needs to improve visually without being told, build creative briefs from product and customer analysis, and bring ideas from concept through implementation .


The right person understands that great Amazon creative is not just about making listings look better. It is about increasing click-through rate, improving conversion rate, answering buyer decision questions visually, and creating a premium brand experience that feels custom, polished, and mobile-first.



What You’ll Own


You will lead design for:

  • CTR-optimized main images
  • Amazon infographics
  • A+ Content
  • Amazon Brand Stores
  • Amazon ad creatives



What You’ll Be Responsible For


  • Develop high-converting Amazon creative that is visually premium, detail-oriented, mobile-optimized, and aligned to each brand’s positioning
  • Translate product analysis, competitor analysis, review mining, and buyer research into strong visual concepts
  • Build creative briefs independently based on our internal product analysis process
  • Create designs that clearly answer buyer decision questions using strong hierarchy, thoughtful white space, and strategic visual storytelling
  • Use design flow intentionally in A+ Content and Brand Stores to guide the shopper’s eye and improve engagement
  • Identify visual weaknesses and missed opportunities in product listings without needing step-by-step direction
  • Recommend what should be improved across images, modules, storefronts, and ad creatives based on conversion principles
  • Bring ideas from ideation to execution, including concepting, layout, design, revision, and final production-ready files
  • Leverage AI tools to augment product photography, generate lifestyle imagery, and accelerate creative workflows while maintaining a premium, realistic output
  • Ensure all work is marketplace-compliant, polished, and built for conversion
  • Self-audit all work for alignment, consistency, accuracy, realism, proportion, mobile readability, and premium brand presentation
  • Partner with strategy and account teams to prioritize the highest-impact visual opportunities
  • Support A/B testing initiatives and use testing data to inform creative recommendations



What We’re Looking For


  • 5+ years of graphic design experience
  • Strong portfolio of ecommerce design work
  • Strong understanding of Amazon , including the role of main images, image sequencing, A+ flow, and Store navigation
  • Ability to work independently and proactively
  • Strong eye for layout, hierarchy, whitespace, typography, composition, and premium visual presentation
  • Deep attention to detail & your superpower is communication
  • Experience collaborating in a fast-paced environment



Required Skills


  • Expert-level proficiency in Adobe Photoshop
  • Strong working knowledge of design and organizational tools like Figma, Asana, Trello
  • Experience with AI design tools, including Nano Banana, Scalable or comparable
  • Familiarity with A/B testing workflows for creative



What Great Looks Like in This Role


  • You can look at a listing and quickly identify what is hurting CTR or conversion
  • You know how to visually communicate product value without overloading the image
  • You understand how to make creative feel premium, not generic
  • You use AI as an enhancement tool, not a shortcut for low-quality work
  • You care about the details that separate average creative from exceptional creative



Why Work With Us


  • High-impact creative: Your work directly influences CTR, CVR, and revenue


  • Growth-focused brands: Not low-quality, mass-production design work


  • Competitive Salary: Up to $3,000/mo depending on experience and expertise.


  • 100% Remote: Work from anywhere in the world, as long as you have a strong internet signal.


  • Work Hours: 9AM–5PM CST


  • Growth Opportunities: Be one of our first 10 hires and play a key role in shaping our processes, culture, and future. Grow with an agency that values proactive thinkers, ownership mentality, and people-first leadership.


  • Learn cutting-edge Amazon growth strategies from ex-Amazon employees and industry pros.

title: SAP S/4 HANA BRIM Application Expert (Experto en aplicaciones SAP S/4 HANA BRIM)
description:
ASSA ABLOY Global Solutions is rolling out SAP S/4 HANA across the Division which will enable and support its business expansion strategy in line with the new operating business model.


PRIMARY JOB PURPOSE

Responsible to deliver design and system configuration for the BRIM module in SAP S/4HANA, ensuring successful rollout and adoption of standardized Service-to-Cash processes across business units. The candidate is responsible for translating business requirements into system solutions, managing data migration, testing, training, and post-go-live support, while aligning with SAP best practices and project timelines.


KEY POSITION ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Being part of Global IT team and responsible for SAP BRIM (Billing and Revenue Innovation Management) configuration and associated developments are designed, built, tested & deployed according to S/4 HANA best practices.
  • Facilitate and support workstream managers / Solution Architects & leads right from requirement gathering, solution design with focus on Sales and Customer Service processes and integration of same with operations, finance & product management workstreams.
  • Analyse business requirements related to subscription order management, subscription billing, contract management, and convergent charging.
  • Configure and customize SAP BRIM components including SOM (Subscription Order Management), CC (Convergent Charging), CI (Convergent Invoicing), and FI-CA (Contract Accounting).
  • Responsible for creating/maintaining functional specifications for WRICEF (Workflow, Report, Interface, Conversion, Enhancement, Forms) objects.
  • Perform configuration, testing, training, migration, cutover, go-live and hyper care activities.
  • Support incidents or change requests for the live Business units.


SELECTION CRITERIA

Essential:

  • Bachelor / master’s degree in business, Computer Science, or equivalent discipline is required with minimum 10 years of consulting experience with multiple Industries.
  • Minimum 2 full lifecycle implementations / roll outs & support experience in BRIM module in S/4 HANA projects with related modules SOM, CI, CC and FI-CA.
  • Hands-on experience in configuring BRIM components and managing end-to-end billing cycles.
  • Understanding on SAP Best Practices in BRIM and SD modules and their integrations & technology.
  • Experience in S/4HANA environment and Fiori applications.
  • Strong communication skills in English, self-driven and motivated.
  • Ability to manage and deliver multiple priorities in a constrained timeline


Desirable:

  • SAP S/4 HANA Certification in SAP BRIM.
  • Knowledge of new features in SAP S/4HANA like embedded analytics, user experience using Fiori, SAP cloud platform
  • Exposure to SAP BTP or cloud-based BRIM extensions.
  • Basic ABAP debugging or familiarity with enhancement frameworks.


WORK ENVIRONMENT FACTORS

  • Office based/Remote with occasional international travel.
  • Health and Safety accountability statements.
  • Working times are European time zone, however open to be available in APAC/US time zone as well for the need basis.

title: Delivery Lead
description:
Required Skills & Experience


5+ years of experience in delivery lead role

Experience delivering data and analytics products in a production environment

Working knowledge of:

• ETL processes and data pipelines

• BI tools such as Power BI or Tableau

Strong communication skills with the ability to translate between business, product, and engineering teams

Demonstrated ability to identify issues early and escalate effectively


Nice to Have Skills & Experience


Experience supporting logistics, transportation, or pricing analytics initiatives

Background working with Azure-based data ecosystems

Familiarity with database backends and data modeling concepts

Experience operating in complex, cross-functional enterprise environments


Job Description


Insight Global is looking to add a Delivery Lead to their client’s Data & Analytics organization. This person will own the end-to-end delivery of logistics and transportation initiatives, ensuring solutions are delivered on time with high quality and operational reliability. They will support and enhance Transportation Management Systems (TMS) and related logistics data products, ensuring business users have accurate, timely data to drive insights into transportation performance, pricing, and KPIs, etc. They will act as a key liaison between business, product, and engineering teams and will be responsible for translating business needs into clear, actionable requirements, identifying gaps in definition, and partnering with Product Managers to clarify scope before work reaches engineering. They will work closely with engineers to provide business context, facilitate effective technical discussions, and proactively identify and escalate risks related to delivery quality and timelines. This role also leads or supports incident management for data, analytics, and logistics systems by triaging issues, determining actionability, collaborating with engineering on resolution, and ensuring incidents are documented and addressed to prevent recurrence. They will support sprint planning, backlog refinement, delivery tracking, and continuous improvement across delivery processes.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Java Sênior
description:
Quem somos nós?


Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas. .
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?


Estamos em busca de um/uma Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Java Sênior para fazer parte do nosso movimento. Quem ocupar esta posição será responsável por implementar e orquestrar microsserviços modernos, arquiteturas orientadas a eventos (Kafka/RabbitMQ) assumindo entregas de ponta a ponta, da implementação ao deploy em produção. Esperamos que você encabece integrações complexas, atue no tuning avançado das aplicações e suas integrações com bancos de dados (SQL/NoSQL) e seja protagonista na adoção de tecnologias emergentes, além de criar ambientes de confiança para revisões de código de alto padrão.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?

  • Implementar e evoluir arquiteturas de aplicações de microsserviços e sistemas orientados a eventos, garantindo escalabilidade, resiliência e manutenibilidade ao longo do tempo;
  • Elaborar templates de arquitetura de aplicação de referência para o time, sempre que demandado;
  • Protagonizar decisões técnicas com visão de impacto, explicitando trade-offs para o time e para produto, mesmo em cenários com informações incompletas;
  • Garantir a estabilidade dos sistemas em produção, realizando a resposta a incidentes, definindo prioridades de correção e propondo melhorias estruturais para evitar recorrência;
  • Implementar e disseminar práticas de observabilidade (OpenTelemetry, APM com Datadog/NewRelic/Dynatrace) e tracing distribuído para aumentar a previsibilidade operacional;
  • Conduzir code reviews de alto padrão, orientando o time em boas práticas de arquitetura, design patterns, testes e segurança;
  • Atuar em integrações complexas com sistemas internos e externos, aplicando padrões de resiliência como Circuit Breaker, Retry, Fallback e SAGA;
  • Identificar gargalos e oportunidades de melhoria em queries SQL, estratégias de cache e configurações de pool de conexões para otimizar a performance das aplicações;
  • Apoiar diretamente líderes técnicos (Tech Leads) em acordos técnicos entre squad, produto e demais áreas, traduzindo complexidade técnica em impacto de negócio de forma clara e rastreável;
  • Explorar e adotar tecnologias emergentes de forma responsável, avaliando custo, benefício e risco antes da incorporação no stack do time.
  • Aprimorar continuamente os processos e práticas de desenvolvimento, aplicando técnicas de uso de Inteligência Artificial para otimizar o desenvolvimento de software, de forma avançada e responsável.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa ter:


  • Profundidade em Java avançado: Multithread, gerenciamento de memória/GC, Virtual Threads (Java 21) e domínio das diferenças entre versões LTS, bem como domínio total de programação funcional;
  • Domínio amplo de Design Patterns com capacidade de reconhecer o momento certo de aplicá-los; entendimento de como a Injeção de Dependência funciona internamente (Reflection/Proxies);
  • Experiência sólida com Spring (Boot, Data, Security) e uso de frameworks reativos;
  • Domínio de estratégias de resiliência em integrações: Circuit Breaker, Retry, Fallback e SAGA (ex: Resilience4j); domínio do conceito de Idempotência;
  • Experiência prática e profunda com Kafka (Partições, Offsets, Consumer Groups) e RabbitMQ avançado (DLQ, Retry Policies, Exchanges);
  • Capacidade de realizar tuning de queries SQL, criação de índices, e estratégias de cache (local vs distribuído, TTL e invalidação);
  • Domínio avançado de pelo menos um banco de dados relacional e um banco NoSQL (MongoDB ou DynamoDB);
  • Domínio de observabilidade avançada com OpenTelemetry, pelo menos uma ferramenta de APM (Datadog/NewRelic/Dynatrace) e tracing distribuído;
  • Experiência prática com Kubernetes. Não irá administrar diretamente, mas é necessária experiência de interpretação do ecossistema;
  • Experiência prática com componentes de pelo menos uma Cloud (AWS ou GCP)
  • Capacidade real e experiência em Documentação como código usando Mermaid ou PlantUML através de arquivos markdown;
  • Domínio sólido de estratégias em pelo menos uma ferramenta de IA assistida (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Antigravity ou Claude Code), bem como experiência prática de consumo de pelo menos 1 tipo de MCP Server através destas ferramentas.


Você irá se destacar se:


  • Ser committer ativo em repositórios open-source relevantes;
  • Experiência em tuning avançado de integração com bancos de dados usando JPA e pool de conexões (ex: HikariCP);
  • Ter realizado publicações técnicas em canais relevantes (blog, artigos, palestras, conferências);
  • Experiência com frameworks como Apache Camel ou outros de integração de sistemas (ESB/EDA);
  • Experiência em arquitetura orientada a eventos (EDA) de alta complexidade;
  • Conhecimento ou experiência com bancos de dados colunares ou baseados em grafos;
  • Certificações Cloud (AWS ou GCP) ativas;
  • Implementação de API Gateways (Kong, Sensedia, AWS API Gateway) via configuração e/ou código;
  • Experiência em integração arquitetural de APIs de LLM (LangChain, RAG/bancos vetoriais) ou criação de soluções próprias baseadas em IA;
  • Capacidade de liderar migrações de monolitos para microsserviços;
  • Ter implementado mais de dois exemplos de servidores MCP de alta complexidade técnica.


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?


  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;
  • Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Mental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Física - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass;
  • Seguro de vida.


Todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas e abertas a pessoas de todas as identidades de gênero, orientações sexuais, idades, etnias, culturas, origens, crenças, deficiências e outras diversidades. Acreditamos que a pluralidade enriquece nosso time e promove um ambiente de trabalho mais inovador e colaborativo.
