title: Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market. NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits. We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.Role and responsibilities The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo's projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality. The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.Primary roles and responsibilities include: Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs);
plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions. Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current. Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner. Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks). Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation Lead closure of contract signatures. Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo's data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records). Reforestation delivery enablement Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows). Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation. Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints). Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos). Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism. Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date. Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements. Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met. Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects;
proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.Skills and attributes To perform successfully in this role, you will have: A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers. Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science. Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups. Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams. A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision. A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting. A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or BahiaSubmission instructions Email CV and brief cover letter towith subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Devops Engineer
description:
We're looking for a DevOps / Cloud Lead who knows how to design, automate, and operate cloud infrastructure. This role focuses heavily on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) due to a strategic partnership in that ecosystem. Many of our clients are migrating infrastructure to OCI or need help operating multi-cloud environments. We need someone who can design solutions, automate processes, and solve infrastructure problems, not just maintain pipelines.Why this role exists We have a strategic partnership with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Clients are asking us to migrate infrastructure to OCI, and many of them also need ongoing DevOps operations and architecture support. We need someone who can own this technically. Not just executing tasks, but executing the task is an important part of the job as well. Design solutions. Talk to clients. Automate migrations. Coordinate engineers. And when necessary, jump in and fix things yourself.TL;
DR You will help lead cloud and DevOps initiatives at Quave. Your job is to: Lead cloud migrations to OCI Design cloud architectures Automate migrations and infrastructure Coordinate DevOps engineers Talk directly to clients Help build repeatable DevOps processes You must be strong in OCI, comfortable with AWS / Azure / GCP, hands-on, obsessed with automation, and comfortable discussing technical architecture with clients. English is a plus, not required.This is not a ticket-based DevOps job If you're looking for a role where you maintain Jenkins pipelines, restart servers, open support tickets, and wait for instructions, this is not the role for you. This role is about designing and solving infrastructure problems. We want someone who can look at a system and think:\ "We can automate 80% of this.\" And then actually build the automation.What you'll actually do Cloud Architecture Design infrastructure for systems running in OCI, AWS, Azure, and GCP, migrating from one to another.Cloud Migrations A lot of our work will be migrations like AWS → OCI, Azure → OCI, GCP → OCI. Your job is not just to do the migration, but to help us turn migrations into repeatable processes, scripts, templates, automation and tooling so that each migration becomes easier than the last.Automation We want to automate everything that can be automated: Automated infrastructure provisioning Migration scripts CI/CD pipelines Environment replication Monitoring setups If you like writing scripts that replace hours of manual work, you'll enjoy this role.Client Discussions You will often join calls with clients to understand infrastructure problems, design migration strategies, estimate effort, and propose solutions. You must be comfortable discussing technical topics clearly.Leading DevOps Engineers As the DevOps work grows, you'll coordinate other engineers working on projects, reviewing architecture, guiding implementations, and ensuring quality.What we're looking for You probably have many years working with infrastructure. But more importantly, you have good instincts about systems. You likely: Love automating infrastructure Hate manual processes Can quickly understand unfamiliar systems Are comfortable debugging production environments Enjoy designing architectures Can communicate clearly with both engineers and clients You should also be comfortable using AI tools to accelerate your work. Tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor can dramatically increase productivity when used well. We expect you to take advantage of that.Technical Expectations Cloud Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) - important AWS Azure GCPDevOps Docker Kubernetes Terraform or other Infrastructure-as-Code tools CI/CD pipelines Linux systems administration Networking fundamentals Automation Comfortable writing scripts in Bash, Python, Go, or similar.Languages Portuguese required. English is a plus as some clients are international, so it may eventually become useful in the future, but it's not required.Why work with Quave We are a small, profitable, independent company. No investors. No corporate bureaucracy. We focus on doing great work for clients and building great software. Things we value: Speed. Quality. Pragmatism. Autonomy. Quave literally stands for Quality (Qua) and Velocity (Ve).Pay and Benefits This is a full-time remote position. Compensation will depend on experience. Fully remote work Flexible hours 22 days paid time off per year Quarterly bonus based on company performance AI allowance for productivity tools We work as a distributed team of independent contractors.Hiring Process Application review Technical conversation Architecture discussion Conversation(s) with one or more partners This is a leadership role and you will coordinate other engineers as the DevOps work grows. But at Quave our leaders are hands-on. You should be comfortable writing automation and infrastructure code yourself when needed.

title: Manager, Corporate Development - M&A Origination & Deal Sourcing
description: Gemini Group (csigemini.Com) is part of Constellation Software Inc. (TSX: CSU), a global acquirer, builder, and manager of vertical market software businesses. Gemini partners with high-quality software companies, providing long-term operational support, capital, and strategic guidance to help them grow sustainably. Our portfolio spans multiple vertical markets and operates through decentralized business units that are deeply embedded in their respective industries. Learn more here: csigemini.ComThe Role The Manager, Corporate Development will play a critical role in identifying, building, and nurturing strategic relationships that lead to new acquisition opportunities for Gemini Group.In this role, you will engage with software company leaders. Your success will be measured by your ability to cultivate meaningful, trust-based relationships that ultimately result in Gemini acquiring high-quality software businesses. Relationship-building in this role is a long-term endeavor - often taking multiple years from first contact to acquisition. Success requires persistence, strategic thinking, disciplined pipeline management, high-quality market research, and a consistent ability to add value across many conversations.As Gemini continues to expand its presence globally, this Brazil based role will also play a foundational part in helping scale Gemini's M&A capability in the LATAM market. Over time, the Manager, Corporate Development will have the opportunity to contribute to the growth of a localized M&A function - including shaping best practices and helping establish Gemini as a preferred partner for LATAM software entrepreneurs. This is a unique chance to be a builder of Gemini's deal-sourcing footprint in Brazil while advancing your own leadership trajectory within the organization.Key Outcomes Develop, manage, and expand an M&A pipeline using Salesforce CRM, including market mapping within assigned software verticals. Meet and exceed weekly and quarterly sourcing and relationship-building KPIs. Work both independently and in collaboration with Gemini's M&A leadership to efficiently evaluate potential acquisition opportunities. Ensure accurate categorization and allocation of leads within relevant portfolio verticals. Effectively screen and qualify opportunities at the top of the acquisition funnel to support Portfolio Managers and operating teams. Support the long-term build-out of Gemini's LATAM/Brazil M&A presence by contributing to sourcing processes, knowledge sharing, and future team development. Engage directly with founders, CEOs, and controlling shareholders, conducting high-quality M&A conversations to understand ownership dynamics, M&A insights, motivations, business insights and timing of a future, potential deal. Qualify opportunities through initial commercial, operational, and financial assessment, filtering deals before internal escalation. Coordinate internally with global teams (Perseus / CSI) to align on pipeline prioritization and strategic fit. Maintain structured tracking of interactions and insights (CRM-driven), ensuring continuity and depth of relationship over time.Relevant Experience & Competencies At least three years of experience in M&A business development, with proven involvement in various aspects of M&A such as mandate origination (including private equity), initial contact with key decision-makers, deal negotiation, or client-facing roles in M&A or finance within the software or technology sector. Experience in outbound deal origination planning. Previous exposure on relationship-building meetings (virtual or in-person) with company owners to explore strategic M&A opportunities. Demonstrated interest in building a long-term career in software investing, M&A, or corporate development. Track record of high performance in business development, entrepreneurship, or other competitive environments. Strong executive presence with the ability to confidently engage senior leaders, including CEOs, investors, and advisors. Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working autonomously. Self-motivated, proactive, and results-driven with a strong sense of urgency.Other Requirements Willingness to travel occasionally within Brazil and broader LATAM as well as internationally to Canada, the U.S., and Portugal. Professional working proficiency in both English and Portuguese is required. Professional working proficiency in Spanish is a bonus.

title: Market Intelligence Manager - Americas
description: Summary of Job DutiesEnsure their regional team fulfils the roles and responsibilities of: Customer development Lead opportunity assessment: proactively engage in customer development, leverage marketing intelligence capability to assess customer opportunity, generate customer leads from current or potential opportunities driving from new developed product and formulation. Customer development action plan: proactively engage in action plan formulation, and engage in customer communication and execution Customer solution proposal: coordinate external resources to design customized market service plan based on customer's need Customer relationship management Proactively engage in relationship mgmt. with KA's marketing related departments, gathering market insights to support R&D and BD Marketing service: Delivery & after-sales: responsible for leveraging internal capability and external resources to deliver marketing service and after-salesMain ResponsibilitiesAlthough the position is a management role the candidate also expected to be hands on and involved wherever required for the regional team to carry out the following responsibilities:Market Research To visit customer site with sales and also collect market information in their region such as: Customer Survey Analysis Customer service needs/opportunities Customer's org chart Customer's end consumer insights and trends Prospects and opportunity analysis Category Analysis Sales Channels Competitive landscapeMarketing Support Service Help promote, drive and expand our added value service to our customers to provide them with our 360 marketing solution Market Research/Business Intelligence Receipe support `zSales distributionAccount Based Marketing Will be responsible to perform research to find high-value accounts to target as well as spend time developing growth strategies from their findings. They will ensure marketing activities line up with strategies developed and ultimately translate plans to the sales team for execution. They need to ensure the follow steps are covered: Identify high-value target accounts –Identify key accounts that have the potential to contribute the most to the revenue of your company. Conduct research on those accounts- Get a good snapshot of customer needs and pain points, as well as where they are in their customer journey. Develop customized marketing campaigns- Using information you learned in the research phase to inform your strategy, develop creative assets that will resonate with the target account. Run customized marketing campaigns- Launch your campaigns to the target account. Measure customized marketing campaigns- Analyze the data to see how your campaigns are performing.Online Marketing Will be in charge of creating localized content regularly update the following marketing channels in their assigned region. Webinars SEO –Quarterly updates on the regional assigned webpage Social media– Weekly updates on social media platforms in where they are based – language will depend on where they are based Email marketing– Monthly articles that can be distributed for sales use in their regions.Offline Marketing Will handle the planning and implementation of offline marketing tasks in the assigned region which could cover Exhibitions Roadshows Print (Quarterly updates) PowerPoint presentations (Company introductions, products or service introductions)Public Relations Build up media relations and 'Distribution Media List' for future press release distribution in their assigned region. Ensure appearance on at least one reputable news website in their assigned region.Qualifications (Education/Knowledge/Working Experience)Master's degree in a Marketing related discipline. Around 10 years of experience Knowledgable in hands on B2B2C marketing as well as the consumer market in the beverage industry.Skills NeededMarket Research and Analysis:The ability to conduct thorough market research, analyze data, and draw actionable insights is crucial for understanding the target market, consumer behavior, and industry trends. Strategic Planning:Regional Marketing Managers must be adept at developing and executing marketing strategies that align with overall business objectives. This includes setting clear goals, defining KPIs, and creating actionable plans. Team Leadership and Management:Effective leadership skills are important for managing and motivating a team of marketing professionals. This includes providing guidance, setting expectations, and facilitating collaboration. Cross-Functional Collaboration:Regional Marketing Managers need to work closely with various departments like sales, product development, and supply chain to ensure that marketing initiatives are aligned with overall business operations. Brand Management:They should have the ability to maintain and enhance the brand image in the specified region. This involves ensuring consistency in messaging, visual identity, and customer experience. Campaign Management:This skill involves planning, executing, and optimizing marketing campaigns. It requires the ability to set clear objectives, target the right audience, and measure the effectiveness of campaigns. Budget Management:Effective allocation and management of marketing budgets are essential for maximizing return on investment (ROI) and ensuring that resources are used efficiently. Data Analysis and Interpretation:Proficiency in using data analytics tools to measure campaign performance, track key metrics, and derive actionable insights is crucial for making informed marketing decisions. Communication Skills:Strong written and verbal communication skills are necessary for conveying marketing messages effectively to various stakeholders, including team members, executives, and external partners. Adaptability and Flexibility:The ability to adapt to changing market conditions, consumer preferences, and industry trends is vital for staying competitive and achieving long-term success. Problem-Solving Skills:Regional Marketing Managers should be able to identify challenges and develop creative solutions to overcome them. This includes being resourceful and thinking critically. Cultural Awareness and Sensitivity:Especially in a regional role, understanding and respecting cultural nuances and preferences is important for tailoring marketing strategies to specific markets. Time Management:Effectively prioritizing tasks and managing time to meet deadlines is essential in a fast-paced marketing environment. Tech-Savviness:Familiarity with marketing technology tools and platforms, as well as proficiency in relevant software and applications, is important for executing marketing initiatives efficiently. Negotiation Skills:The ability to negotiate and build partnerships with external stakeholders, such as agencies, vendors, and media outlets, can be crucial for successful marketing campaigns.

title: Sap S/4 Hana Brim Application Expert
description: ASSA ABLOY Global Solutions is rolling out SAP S/4 HANA across the Division which will enable and support its business expansion strategy in line with the new operating business model.PRIMARY JOB PURPOSE Responsible to deliver design and system configuration for the BRIM module in SAP S/4HANA, ensuring successful rollout and adoption of standardized Service-to-Cash processes across business units. The candidate is responsible for translating business requirements into system solutions, managing data migration, testing, training, and post-go-live support, while aligning with SAP best practices and project timelines.KEY POSITION ACCOUNTABILITIES Being part of Global IT team and responsible for SAP BRIM (Billing and Revenue Innovation Management) configuration and associated developments are designed, built, tested & deployed according to S/4 HANA best practices. Facilitate and support workstream managers / Solution Architects & leads right from requirement gathering, solution design with focus on Sales and Customer Service processes and integration of same with operations, finance & product management workstreams. Analyse business requirements related to subscription order management, subscription billing, contract management, and convergent charging. Configure and customize SAP BRIM components including SOM (Subscription Order Management), CC (Convergent Charging), CI (Convergent Invoicing), and FI-CA (Contract Accounting). Responsible for creating/maintaining functional specifications for WRICEF (Workflow, Report, Interface, Conversion, Enhancement, Forms) objects. Perform configuration, testing, training, migration, cutover, go-live and hyper care activities. Support incidents or change requests for the live Business units.SELECTION CRITERIA Essential: Bachelor / master's degree in business, Computer Science, or equivalent discipline is required with minimum 10 years of consulting experience with multiple Industries. Minimum 2 full lifecycle implementations / roll outs & support experience in BRIM module in S/4 HANA projects with related modules SOM, CI, CC and FI-CA. Hands-on experience in configuring BRIM components and managing end-to-end billing cycles. Understanding on SAP Best Practices in BRIM and SD modules and their integrations & technology. Experience in S/4HANA environment and Fiori applications. Strong communication skills in English, self-driven and motivated. Ability to manage and deliver multiple priorities in a constrained timelineDesirable: SAP S/4 HANA Certification in SAP BRIM. Knowledge of new features in SAP S/4HANA like embedded analytics, user experience using Fiori, SAP cloud platform Exposure to SAP BTP or cloud-based BRIM extensions. Basic ABAP debugging or familiarity with enhancement frameworks.WORK ENVIRONMENT FACTORS Office based/Remote with occasional international travel. Health and Safety accountability statements. Working times are European time zone, however open to be available in APAC/US time zone as well for the need basis.We are the ASSA ABLOY Group Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.As we welcome new people on board, it's important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:

Cada pessoa deve ser um especialista na empresa e em seu segmento. Nós elevamos continuamente o nível para fornecer produtos, serviços e processos de alta qualidade. Elaborar templates de arquitetura de aplicação de referência para o time, sempre que demandado;

Atuar em integrações complexas com sistemas internos e externos, aplicando padrões de resiliência como Circuit Breaker, Retry, Fallback e SAGA;

Apoiar diretamente líderes técnicos (Tech Leads) em acordos técnicos entre squad, produto e demais áreas, traduzindo complexidade técnica em impacto de negócio de forma clara e rastreável;
Explorar e adotar tecnologias emergentes de forma responsável, avaliando custo, benefício e risco antes da incorporação no stack do time. Aprimorar continuamente os processos e práticas de desenvolvimento, aplicando técnicas de uso de Inteligência Artificial para otimizar o desenvolvimento de software, de forma avançada e responsável.Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa ter:Profundidade em Java avançado: Multithread, gerenciamento de memória/GC, Virtual Threads (Java 21) e domínio das diferenças entre versões LTS, bem como domínio total de programação funcional;
Domínio amplo de DesignPatterns com capacidade de reconhecer o momento certo de aplicá-los;
entendimento de como a Injeção de Dependência funciona internamente (Reflection/Proxies);
Experiência sólida com Spring (Boot, Data, Security) e uso de frameworks reativos;
Domínio de estratégias de resiliência em integrações: Circuit Breaker, Retry, Fallback e SAGA (ex: Resilience4j);
domínio do conceito de Idempotência;

Experiência prática comcomponentes de pelo menos uma Cloud (AWS ou GCP) Capacidade real e experiência em Documentação como código usando Mermaid ou PlantUML através de arquivos markdown;
Domínio sólido de estratégias em pelo menos uma ferramenta de IA assistida (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Antigravity ou Claude Code), bem como experiência prática de consumo de pelo menos 1 tipo de MCP Server através destas ferramentas.Você irá se destacar se:Ser committer ativo em repositórios open-source relevantes;

Ter realizado publicações técnicas em canais relevantes (blog, artigos, palestras, conferências);

Experiência em integração arquitetural de APIs de LLM (LangChain, RAG/bancos vetoriais) ou criação de soluções próprias baseadas em IA;
Capacidade de liderar migrações de monolitos para microsserviços;

title: English Teacher
description: Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you! Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach! Whether you're looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we've got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire? You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts. If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out. When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone). Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.Minimum Requirements:Portuguese as a first language. C1 or C2 Level English Speaker University degree in English Teaching or related area. One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language. Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection. Must pass a criminal background check. Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.Who we are: Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Analista De Segurança Da Informação Sênior
description:

da Fisia, distribuidoraoficial da Nike no Brasil, da FitDance e da OneFan, aqui o movimento não para. Praticante ou entusiasta, fã ou apaixonado: o Grupo SBF é pra você. Atuar na sustentação de certificações e avaliações regulatórias. Apoiar o programa de adequação e sustentação à LGPD. Apoiar na avaliação de Privacy by Design e Security by Design.Gestão de Riscos e Controles Conduzir análises de riscos de segurança (técnicos, operacionais e regulatórios). Manter matriz de riscos atualizada e integrada à estratégia corporativa.Regulamentações e Normas Atuar nos temas relacionados a PCI DSS. Garantir aderência a requisitos regulatórios (LGPD, normas contratuais). Traduzir requisitos regulatórios em controles técnicos e processuais aplicáveis. Apoiar áreas de negócio na interpretação de requisitos de segurança.Integração com Áreas Internas Trabalhar em parceria com Jurídico, Compliance, Auditoria, Tecnologia, Privacidade e áreas de negócio. Apoiar comitês de risco e segurança. Contribuir com indicadores, dashboards executivos e relatórios estratégicos.Perfil Esperado Visão estratégica de segurança alinhada ao negócio. Forte capacidade analítica e de priorização baseada em risco. Comunicação clara para públicos técnicos e executivos. Capacidade de estruturar processos e elevar maturidade organizacional. Mentalidade colaborativa e orientada a governança preventiva.Requisitos TécnicosObrigatórios: Experiência sólida em Governança, Riscos e Compliance (GRC). Vivência com ISO 27001/27002 e/ou NIST. Experiência em auditorias e avaliação de controles. Conhecimento em gestão de riscos corporativos. Diferenciais: Certificações como: CISM, CRISC, ISO 27001 LA/LI, PCI ISA. Experiência em varejo, e-commerce ou meios de pagamento. Experiência com PCI DSS Experiência com ferramentas de GRC.Indicadores de Sucesso Evolução do nível de maturidade em segurança. Redução de riscos críticos. Aderência comprovada a PCI DSS e demais normas. Redução de não conformidades em auditorias. Fortalecimento da cultura de governança e controles.Contexto de Atuação A posição integra o White Team, com foco em governança, prevenção, controles e maturidade do programa de Segurança da Informação, atuando de forma estratégica e transversal com múltiplas áreas de negócio.

title: Especialista Sistemas Sap Success Factors
description: OGrupo Petrópolisé a única grande empresa do setor cervejeiro com capital 100% nacional. Produz as marcas de cerveja Itaipava, Cabaré, Crystal, Lokal, Black Princess, Petra e Weltenburger, Brassaria Ampolis com os rótulos Cacildis, Biritis, Ditriguis e Forévis, as vodkas Blue Spirit Ice e Nordka, a Cabaré Ice, os energéticos TNT Energy Drink e Magneto, o refrigerante It!, o isotônico TNT Sports Drink e a água Petra. Com oito fábricas em operação e aproximadamente 132 centros de distribuição, o grupo é responsável pela geração de aproximadamente 22 mil empregos diretos.Por meio dos projetos ambientais, promove o plantio e manutenção de milhares de árvores, além de ações de sustentabilidade e programa de educação ambiental para escolas municipais. Conta também com o Saber Beber, programa comprometido em orientar as pessoas sobre os benefícios do consumo moderado e as consequências do consumo exagerado de álcool.O respeito é um dos valores do Grupo Petrópolis, e por isso todas as crenças, identidades culturais, gêneros, idades, raças, opções individuais e pessoas com deficiência são respeitadas e valorizadas. Para todas as nossas vagas consideramos candidatos representados por esta ampla diversidade.Buscamos profissional para atuar na gestão funcional e governança do ecossistema SAP de RH, com foco em SAP SuccessFactors (lado cliente, sem acesso a provisioning), SAP HCM migrando para SAP S/4, garantindo sustentação, evolução e alinhamento estratégico das soluções.Responsabilidades e Requisitos Técnicos:1. Diferencial ter conhecimento na navegação do BTP e IAS. Diferencial ter conhecimento em SFSF EC. Acompanhar roadmap, tendências e atualizações SAP. Analisar release notes, atualizações de quarters, avaliar impactos no ambiente, abrir e acompanhar chamados no SAP for Me. Entender e suportar as liberações de Acessos conforme papéis e responsabilidades da governança GP. Módulos SFSF atualmente instalados: EP, LMS, Recruiting, Metas e Desempenho, Carreira e Sucessão.2. Gestão de Sistemas SatélitesMelhorias, sustentação e governança com foco em: Conhecimentos em SAP HCM em PA, OM, PY, BN, TM e eSocial. Diferencial com conhecimentos no Ronda (controle de ponto), DMS (gestão documental). Monitorar e direcionar de atendimento ao suporte de interfaces e integrações aos sistemas que compõe o landscape de soluções de RH Atuar em chamados específicos e/ou em incidentes críticos. Apoiar e suportar à obrigações legais dentro dos processos de RH, tais como: eSocial, admissões, afastamentos, atualização sindicais, desligamento, movimentações, LGPD, etc. Apoiar demais sistemas integrados ao ecosistema de RH como: SOC, eBox, AD Azure, etc.3. Quando em projetos, garantir transição adequada para sustentação.4. title: Arquiteto De Soluções - Com Foco Em Ia
description:
Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo:NoGrupo Fleury, acreditamos que o futuro da saúde será cada vez mais data-driven, inteligente e digital. Estamos construindo um ecossistema tecnológico que integra dados, inteligência artificial, automação e plataformas digitais, com o objetivo de transformar a jornada de cuidado em saúde. Buscamos um(a) Arquiteto(a) de Soluções, que será responsável por projetar e evoluir soluções tecnológicas escaláveis que utilizem IA, dados e plataformas cloud para gerar impacto real no negócio.Se você é apaixonado por arquitetura de sistemas, IA generativa, plataformas de dados e cloud computing, essa oportunidade é para você.Principais desafios da posição: - Definir e evoluir a arquitetura de soluções baseadas em Inteligência Artificial, incluindo aplicações de Machine Learning, IA Generativa e automação inteligente. - Projetar arquiteturas modernas baseadas em cloud-native architecture, microservices e arquiteturas orientadas a eventos. - Desenvolver soluções que integrem plataformas de dados, modelos de IA, APIs e sistemas corporativos. - Atuar no desenho de soluções com Large Language Models (LLMs), GenAI, AI Agents e automação baseada em IA. - Definir padrões de arquitetura para soluções que utilizem plataformas de IA em nuvem. - Apoiar squads de engenharia no desenvolvimento de soluções com IA, dados e plataformas digitais. - Garantir que as soluções atendam requisitos de segurança, governança de dados, escalabilidade e observabilidade. - Avaliar novas tecnologias e frameworks emergentes no ecossistema de AI, Data e Cloud Architecture.Tecnologias e plataformas com as quais você irá trabalhar: A arquitetura da companhia envolve um ecossistema moderno de tecnologias, incluindo: Cloud e Plataformas de IA AWS (Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, Lambda, EKS, Aurora, API Gateway) Microsoft Azure (Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Studio, AKS, Data Factory, Synapse) Google Cloud Platform (Vertex AI, BigQuery, Cloud Run, GKE) Inteligência Artificial e Machine Learning LLMs e GenAI (OpenAI, Claude, Llama, Gemini) Frameworks de IA (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face) AI Agents e arquiteturas multi-agent RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) MLOps e LLMOps Arquitetura de Software e Integração Microservices e APIs Event-driven architecture Kafka, RabbitMQ e streaming de dados API Management Engenharia e Plataforma Kubernetes / OpenShift CI/CD e DevOps Observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry) Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, Ansible)Buscamos profissionais com: - Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas correlatas. - Experiência comprovada como Arquiteto de Soluções, Arquiteto de Software ou Arquiteto de Plataforma. - Experiência em arquitetura de soluções baseadas em Cloud Computing (AWS, Azure ou GCP). - Conhecimento em Inteligência Artificial, Machine Learning ou IA Generativa. - Experiência com arquitetura de dados, APIs e integração de sistemas. - Experiência com arquiteturas distribuídas e cloud-native. - Conhecimento em DevOps, CI/CD e observabilidade. - Inglês intermediário ou avançado.Diferenciais importantes: - Experiência com GenAI, AI Agents ou plataformas de IA corporativa. - Experiência com arquitetura de dados e data platforms (Data Lake, Data Mesh ou Lakehouse). - Experiência em ambientes regulados como healthcare, financeiro ou telecom. - Participação em iniciativas de transformação digital baseada em IA.Nosso jeito de trabalhar, buscamos pessoas que: - Estimulem a troca de conhecimento e colaboração entre times. - Invistam continuamente em aprendizado e evolução técnica. - Conectem tecnologia e negócio para gerar impacto real. - Busquem inovação contínua e melhoria das soluções.Informações da vaga:Modelo de Trabalho (Home Office) Carga Horária: 220h Mês - 44h Semanais Escala: Segunda á sexta - feira. Horário de Trabalho: 08h00 ás 17h48Cuidamos de você em cada etapa da sua jornada!Saúde e Bem-estar: - Assistência médica e odontológica para você e sua família;
- Ambulatório com clínica médica ou atendimento por telemedicina;
- Linhas de cuidado especializadas: gestantes, adoção, obesidade, oncologia, entre outras;
- Acesso à plataforma OrienteMe para sessões de terapia e orientação nutricional;
- Licença maternidade epaternidade estendidas;
- Acesso ao Wellhub para práticas esportivas e qualidade de vida.Proteção e estabilidade: - Previdência privada;
- Participação nos lucros;
- Seguro de vida.Facilidades para o dia a dia: - Vale-Alimentação;
- Vale-Refeição;
- Auxílio-Creche;
- Clube de Descontos com lojas, farmácias, viagem, beleza, cultura, lazer, entre outros serviços.Desenvolvimento e educação: - Plataforma de ensino;
- Parcerias educacionais com descontos em cursos e instituições.Aqui, o cuidado vai além dos benefícios — ele está presente em cada momento da sua trajetória.Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, focada na equidade e na valorização das diferenças. Nossas vagas são abertas para todos os públicos e, simbolizando a nossa intencionalidade, oferecemos oportunidades afirmativas.Nosso compromisso vai além do cumprimento das legislações que incentivam a diversidade e inclusão. Trabalhamos ativamente para ampliar a representatividade de nossas pessoas, pensando em raça, etnia, gênero, gerações, pessoas com deficiência e LGBTQIAPN+ em nosso time, além de fortalecer a representatividade de mulheres negras, indígenas, chefes de família.Para conhecer mais sobre o Grupo Fleury, acesse o site: Grupo Fleury informa que a participação em seus processos seletivos é gratuita e nenhuma empresa terceira está autorizada a cobrar valores para a candidatura às vagas, ao treinamento, ao material didático ou qualquer outra despesa relacionada.

description: Position Scope TheFreight Desk Manageris a high-impact leadership role responsible for architecting and overseeing the logistics support function for non-finished goods on a global scale, with a dedicated focus on theLATAM region. This position operates at the intersection of global procurement and operational execution, managing a complex ecosystem of freight forwarders, control towers, and internal stakeholders. The mission is to ensure world-class shipment execution and financial integrity through robust audit structures and the expansion of logistics capabilities in high-growth markets. Responsibilities and Accountabilities Regional Strategy & Expansion:Serve as the primary architect for logistics operations in LATAM, including the enablement of Importer of Record (IOR) operations and regional supplier onboarding. Rate Card Governance:Standardize and maintain global Bulk Air and Ocean rate cardsacross a diverse portfolio of international suppliers to ensure cost consistency and transparency. Strategic Sourcing:Lead RFQs and supplier onboarding initiativesfor logistics, ensuring all partners meet global compliance and service level standards. Governance & Audit Architecture:Design and maintain a global freight audit strategy and control architecture to ensure financial discipline across high-volume global invoice environments. Control Tower Oversight:Drive operational excellence by governing forwarder performance, ensuring industry-leading on-time shipment execution across all transport modes. Automation & Process Engineering:Implement automated invoice approval systems and systemic controls to improve first-pass yield and overall operational efficiency. Stakeholder Management:Partner with global cross-functional teams to support non-standard logistics requirements and rapid-response delivery programs. Mandatory Requirements Experience:Extensive experience in Global Supply Management, Logistics Procurement, or Supply Chain Operations within multinational environments. Regional Expertise:Deep knowledge of theLATAM logistics landscape, including regulatory requirements, customs, and supplier networks. Procurement Mastery:Proven track record inleading RFQsand managing complexlogistics supplier onboardingprocesses. Network Management:Experience managing large-scale global freight forwarder relationships and\ "Control Tower\" operational models. Technical Proficiency:Strong background in Logistics Financial Control (Freight Audit) and managing high-volume, global-scale invoice environments. Leadership:Experience leading international teams and managing external providers across different time zones (APAC, EMEA, AMR). Education:Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, International Trade, or a related field. Languages:Fluency inEnglishis essential for regional and global coordination. Desirable Requirements Advanced Education:MBA or Master's degree. Process Excellence:Certifications in Lean Six Sigma or similar experience. Digital Transformation:Experience implementing AI-driven or automated financial auditing and rate management tools. Rapid Growth Background:Experience managing logistics for hyper-growth programs (e.G., international express expansions or specialized delivery models).

title: Ux & Data-Driven Usability Designer
description: UX & Data-Driven Usability DesignerAbout the Role We are looking for a UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer to help improve the performance of a large-scale digital commerce platform. Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores,e sendo responsável por:Prospectar ativamente novos clientes com o perfil de Grandes Contas. Trabalhar em sinergia com equipes de produtos e operações para garantir a melhor entrega ao cliente.
